title: A2UI Evaluation Dataset Schema
description: Schema for A2UI evaluation datasets and data points.

name.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation sample.

dataset.description: Name of the dataset this data point belongs to. If omitted, inferred from the YAML file name.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this sample tests.

catalog.description: Path to a custom catalog JSON file. Supports the '{version}' placeholder.

messages.description: Ordered chat completion messages preceding and including the final UI generation request.

role.description: The role of the message sender.

tool_calls.description: List of tool calls made by the assistant in this turn.

tool_call_id.description: Identifier linking a tool response turn to its preceding assistant tool call.

promptText.description: Legacy single-turn user prompt (deprecated; automatically migrated to messages).

target.description: Expected outcome and rubric criteria for LLM-as-a-judge scoring. If omitted, defaults to description.

system_prompt.description: Domain-specific system prompt unrelated to A2UI (e.g., application persona, business rules). Merged with the A2UI SDK system prompt during solver execution.

protocol_role.description: A2UI protocol role instruction passed to the SDK prompt generator.

generation_rules.description: A2UI protocol workflow rules appended to the SDK workflow prompt.

allowed_surface_ids.description: Allowed surface IDs for the output.
